en.title: Court Hierarchy & Core Principles
en.mnemonic: Supreme Court sits at the top. Federal Court handles federal-government matters only. RCMP is provincial police everywhere EXCEPT Ontario and Quebec.
keyFactsChecklist: Legal aid available in most communities

en.question: Are judges, politicians, and police bound by Canadian law?
options: Yes — the law applies to everyone, with no person or group above the law
Only judges are exempt; others must comply
en.explanation: Page 75: 'The law in Canada applies to everyone, including judges, politicians and the police.' Page 13 reinforces: 'No person or group is above the law.'

optionAnnotations.explanation: Page 75: 'The law in Canada applies to everyone, including judges, politicians and the police.' Page 13 reinforces: 'No person or group is above the law.'
The opposite of the rule of law. Discover Canada explicitly says no one is above the law.
No such distinction. The law applies to all, on or off duty.
Judges are explicitly listed among those bound by the law on p. 75.

en.question: Canada's judicial system in criminal matters is founded on the presumption of innocence — everyone is innocent until proven guilty.
en.explanation: True. Canada's judicial system in criminal matters is founded on the presumption of innocence.

source.excerpt: Our judicial system is founded on the presumption of innocence in criminal matters, meaning everyone is innocent until proven guilty.

fr.question: Le système judiciaire du Canada, dans les affaires criminelles, est fondé sur la présomption d'innocence — chacun est innocent jusqu'à preuve du contraire.
fr.explanation: Vrai. Le système judiciaire du Canada, en matière criminelle, est fondé sur la présomption d'innocence.

source.excerpt: Notre système judiciaire est fondé sur la présomption d'innocence dans les affaires criminelles, ce qui veut dire que chacun est innocent jusqu'à preuve du contraire.

ar.question: يقوم النظام القضائي الكندي في المسائل الجنائية على افتراض البراءة — الجميع أبرياء حتى تثبت إدانتهم.
ar.explanation: صحيح. يقوم النظام القضائي الكندي في المسائل الجنائية على افتراض البراءة.

en.question: Canada's legal heritage, which underlies due process, includes which of the following?
options: The rule of law, freedom under the law, and democratic principles
Only English common law, with no other traditions
A system with no elected representatives
en.explanation: Canada's legal system is based on a heritage that includes the rule of law, freedom under the law, democratic principles and due process.

source.excerpt: Due process is the principle that the government must respect all of the legal rights a person is entitled to under the law.

fr.question: L'héritage juridique du Canada, qui sous-tend l'application régulière de la loi, comprend lequel des éléments suivants ?
options: La primauté du droit, la liberté prévue par la loi et les principes démocratiques
Seulement la common law britannique, sans autre tradition
Le décret royal sans apport législatif
fr.explanation: Le système juridique du Canada se fonde sur un héritage qui comprend la primauté du droit, la liberté prévue par la loi, les principes démocratiques et l'application régulière de la loi.

source.excerpt: L'application régulière de la loi est le principe selon lequel le gouvernement doit respecter toutes les garanties juridiques auxquelles a droit une personne en vertu de la loi.

ar.question: ما الذي يتضمنه الإرث القانوني الكندي، الذي تقوم عليه الإجراءات القانونية الواجبة؟
options: سيادة القانون، والحرية في ظل القانون، والمبادئ الديمقراطية
القانون العام الإنجليزي فقط، دون أي تقاليد أخرى
المرسوم الملكي دون أي مدخلات تشريعية
ar.explanation: يستند النظام القانوني الكندي إلى إرث يشمل سيادة القانون، والحرية في ظل القانون، والمبادئ الديمقراطية، والإجراءات القانونية الواجبة.

en.question: Does due process apply only to criminal proceedings, or to government actions generally?
options: To government actions generally, not just criminal proceedings
Only to civil lawsuits between private citizens
en.explanation: Due process is the principle that government must respect all the legal rights a person is entitled to under the law - it applies to government action generally, not only in criminal cases.

source.excerpt: Due process is the principle that the government must respect all of the legal rights a person is entitled to under the law.

fr.question: L'application régulière de la loi s'applique-t-elle seulement aux procédures criminelles, ou aux actions du gouvernement en général ?
options: Aux actions du gouvernement en général, pas seulement aux procédures criminelles
Seulement aux poursuites civiles entre citoyens privés
fr.explanation: L'application régulière de la loi est le principe selon lequel le gouvernement doit respecter tous les droits juridiques d'une personne prévus par la loi - elle s'applique aux actions du gouvernement en général, pas seulement en matière criminelle.

source.excerpt: L'application régulière de la loi est le principe selon lequel le gouvernement doit respecter toutes les garanties juridiques auxquelles a droit une personne en vertu de la loi.

ar.question: هل تنطبق الإجراءات القانونية الواجبة فقط على الدعاوى الجنائية، أم على تصرفات الحكومة بشكل عام؟
options: على تصرفات الحكومة بشكل عام، وليس فقط الدعاوى الجنائية
فقط على الدعاوى المدنية بين الأفراد
ar.explanation: الإجراءات القانونية الواجبة هي مبدأ يقضي بأن تحترم الحكومة جميع الحقوق القانونية التي يستحقها الشخص بموجب القانون - وهي تنطبق على تصرفات الحكومة بشكل عام، وليس فقط في القضايا الجنائية.

en.question: 'Due process' means the government may set aside a person's legal rights whenever it decides this serves the public interest.
en.explanation: False. Due process means government must respect all the legal rights a person is entitled to under the law.

source.excerpt: Due process is the principle that the government must respect all of the legal rights a person is entitled to under the law.

fr.question: « L'application régulière de la loi » signifie que le gouvernement peut écarter les garanties juridiques d'une personne lorsqu'il juge que cela sert l'intérêt public.
fr.explanation: Faux. L'application régulière de la loi est le principe selon lequel le gouvernement doit respecter toutes les garanties juridiques auxquelles une personne a droit.

source.excerpt: L'application régulière de la loi est le principe selon lequel le gouvernement doit respecter toutes les garanties juridiques auxquelles a droit une personne en vertu de la loi.

ar.question: 'الإجراءات القانونية الواجبة' تعني أن الحكومة يجوز لها تجاوز الحقوق القانونية للشخص متى قررت أن ذلك يخدم المصلحة العامة.
ar.explanation: خطأ. تعني الإجراءات القانونية الواجبة أن الحكومة يجب أن تحترم جميع الحقوق القانونية التي يستحقها الشخص بموجب القانون.

en.question: If a legal case is appealed all the way to the top in Canada, which court makes the final decision?
en.explanation: As the country's highest court, the Supreme Court of Canada makes the final decision on appeals.

source.excerpt: The Supreme Court of Canada is our country’s highest court.

fr.question: Si une affaire juridique est portée en appel jusqu'au sommet au Canada, quel tribunal rend la décision finale ?
fr.explanation: En tant que plus haut tribunal du pays, la Cour suprême du Canada rend la décision finale sur les appels.

source.excerpt: La Cour suprême du Canada est le plus haut tribunal de notre pays.

ar.question: إذا استُؤنفت قضية قانونية حتى أعلى درجة في كندا، أي محكمة تتخذ القرار النهائي؟
ar.explanation: بصفتها أعلى محكمة في البلاد، تتخذ المحكمة العليا لكندا القرار النهائي في الاستئنافات.

en.question: If a legal dispute directly involves the federal government, which court typically handles it?
en.explanation: The Federal Court of Canada deals specifically with matters concerning the federal government.

source.excerpt: The Federal Court of Canada deals with matters concerning the federal government.

fr.question: Si un litige juridique concerne directement le gouvernement fédéral, quel tribunal s'en occupe généralement ?
options: Une cour municipale des infractions routières
Un tribunal provincial des petites créances
fr.explanation: La Cour fédérale du Canada s'occupe spécifiquement des questions concernant le gouvernement fédéral.

source.excerpt: La Cour fédérale du Canada s'occupe des questions concernant le gouvernement fédéral.

ar.question: إذا كان نزاع قانوني يتعلق مباشرةً بالحكومة الفيدرالية، أي محكمة تتولى النظر فيه عادةً؟
ar.explanation: تتعامل المحكمة الفيدرالية لكندا تحديدًا مع المسائل المتعلقة بالحكومة الفيدرالية.

en.question: If you cannot pay for a lawyer, legal aid services are only available in large cities, not in most communities.
en.explanation: False. Most communities offer legal aid services free of charge or at a low cost.

source.excerpt: If you cannot pay for a lawyer, in most communities there are legal aid services available free of charge or at a low cost.

fr.question: Si vous ne pouvez pas payer les services d'un avocat, les services d'aide juridique ne sont offerts que dans les grandes villes, et non dans la plupart des communautés.
fr.explanation: Faux. La plupart des communautés offrent des services d'aide juridique gratuitement ou à un faible coût.

source.excerpt: Si vous ne pouvez pas payer les services d'un avocat, la plupart des communautés offrent des services d'aide juridique gratuitement ou à un faible coût.

ar.question: إذا لم تستطع دفع أتعاب محامٍ، فإن خدمات المساعدة القانونية متاحة فقط في المدن الكبرى، وليس في معظم المجتمعات.
ar.explanation: خطأ. تقدّم معظم المجتمعات خدمات المساعدة القانونية مجانًا أو بتكلفة منخفضة.

en.question: If you have a concern about police service or conduct in Canada, what can you do?
options: Almost all police forces have a formal complaint process — bring your concerns and seek action
Wait until the next election to vote them out
File a complaint with the Senate
Confront the officer directly with no consequences
en.explanation: Page 77: 'You can also question the police about their service or conduct if you feel you need to. Almost all police forces in Canada have a process by which you can bring your concerns to the police and seek action.'

optionAnnotations.explanation: Page 77: 'You can also question the police about their service or conduct if you feel you need to. Almost all police forces in Canada have a process by which you can bring your concerns to the police and seek action.'
Police aren't elected. Their accountability is through complaint processes, internal oversight, and ultimately the courts.
The Senate is a legislative body (p. 55), not a police oversight body.
Formal complaint processes are the recommended route (p. 77).

en.question: In Canada, are you allowed to question the police about their service or conduct?
options: Yes — almost all police forces have a formal process for citizens to raise concerns and seek action
No — questioning the police is a criminal offence
Only members of Parliament can question the police
en.explanation: Page 77: 'You can also question the police about their service or conduct if you feel you need to. Almost all police forces in Canada have a process by which you can bring your concerns to the police and seek action.'

optionAnnotations.explanation: Page 77: 'You can also question the police about their service or conduct if you feel you need to. Almost all police forces in Canada have a process by which you can bring your concerns to the police and seek action.'
Page 77 explicitly states the opposite. Police are accountable like everyone else under the rule of law.
Any citizen can raise concerns through the formal complaint process (p. 77).
No court order is needed to use the police complaint process.

en.question: In which two provinces does the RCMP NOT serve as the provincial police force?
en.explanation: The RCMP serves as provincial police everywhere except Ontario and Quebec.

source.excerpt: The Royal Canadian Mounted Police (RCMP) enforce federal laws throughout Canada, and serve as the provincial police in all provinces and territories except Ontario and Quebec, as well as in some municipalities.

fr.question: Dans quelles deux provinces la GRC n'agit-elle PAS comme service de police provincial ?
fr.explanation: La GRC sert de police provinciale partout sauf en Ontario et au Québec.

source.excerpt: La Gendarmerie royale du Canada (GRC) applique les lois fédérales dans l'ensemble du Canada et sert de police provinciale dans toutes les provinces et tous les territoires, sauf l'Ontario et le Québec, ainsi que dans certaines municipalités.

ar.question: في أي مقاطعتين لا تعمل الشرطة الملكية الكندية الخيّالة (RCMP) كقوة شرطة إقليمية؟
ar.explanation: تعمل الشرطة الملكية الكندية الخيّالة كشرطة إقليمية في كل مكان باستثناء أونتاريو وكيبيك.

en.question: Lady Justice is depicted blindfolded to symbolize impartiality, being blind to all considerations but the facts.
en.explanation: The blindfold on Lady Justice represents impartiality, meaning justice is blind to everything except the facts.

optionAnnotations.explanation: The blindfold on Lady Justice represents impartiality, meaning justice is blind to everything except the facts.
This statement is accurate, so 'False' is incorrect. The blindfold on Lady Justice represents impartiality, meaning justice is blind to everything except the facts.

en.question: Small claims court handles civil cases involving small sums of money.
en.explanation: Civil cases involving small sums of money are handled by small claims court.

optionAnnotations.explanation: Civil cases involving small sums of money are handled by small claims court.
This statement is accurate, so 'False' is incorrect. Civil cases involving small sums of money are handled by small claims court.

en.question: The Federal Court of Canada handles matters concerning the federal government.
en.explanation: The Federal Court specifically deals with matters concerning the federal government.

optionAnnotations.explanation: The Federal Court specifically deals with matters concerning the federal government.
This statement is accurate, so 'False' is incorrect. The Federal Court specifically deals with matters concerning the federal government.

en.question: The presumption of innocence applies to which type of legal matters in Canada?
en.explanation: The guide specifies the presumption of innocence founds the judicial system in criminal matters.

source.excerpt: Our judicial system is founded on the presumption of innocence in criminal matters, meaning everyone is innocent until proven guilty.

fr.question: La présomption d'innocence s'applique à quel type d'affaires juridiques au Canada ?
fr.explanation: Le guide précise que la présomption d'innocence fonde le système judiciaire dans les affaires criminelles.

source.excerpt: Notre système judiciaire est fondé sur la présomption d'innocence dans les affaires criminelles, ce qui veut dire que chacun est innocent jusqu'à preuve du contraire.

ar.question: على أي نوع من المسائل القانونية ينطبق افتراض البراءة في كندا؟
ar.explanation: يحدد الدليل أن افتراض البراءة يؤسس النظام القضائي في المسائل الجنائية.

en.question: The RCMP does not serve as the provincial police force in Ontario and Quebec.
en.explanation: True. The RCMP serves as provincial police everywhere except Ontario and Quebec.

source.excerpt: The Royal Canadian Mounted Police (RCMP) enforce federal laws throughout Canada, and serve as the provincial police in all provinces and territories except Ontario and Quebec, as well as in some municipalities.

fr.question: La GRC n'agit pas comme service de police provincial en Ontario et au Québec.
fr.explanation: Vrai. La GRC sert de police provinciale partout sauf en Ontario et au Québec.

source.excerpt: La Gendarmerie royale du Canada (GRC) applique les lois fédérales dans l'ensemble du Canada et sert de police provinciale dans toutes les provinces et tous les territoires, sauf l'Ontario et le Québec, ainsi que dans certaines municipalités.

ar.question: لا تعمل الشرطة الملكية الكندية الخيّالة كقوة شرطة إقليمية في أونتاريو وكيبيك.
ar.explanation: صحيح. تعمل الشرطة الملكية الكندية الخيّالة كشرطة إقليمية في كل مكان باستثناء أونتاريو وكيبيك.

en.question: The Supreme Court is Canada's highest court, settling the most important legal disputes.
en.explanation: Canada's highest court, the Supreme Court, settles the most important legal disputes.

optionAnnotations.explanation: Canada's highest court, the Supreme Court, settles the most important legal disputes.
This statement is accurate, so 'False' is incorrect. Canada's highest court, the Supreme Court, settles the most important legal disputes.

en.question: The Supreme Court of Canada is the country's highest court.
en.explanation: True. The Supreme Court of Canada is the country's highest court.

source.excerpt: The Supreme Court of Canada is our country’s highest court.

fr.question: La Cour suprême du Canada est le plus haut tribunal du pays.
fr.explanation: Vrai. La Cour suprême du Canada est le plus haut tribunal du pays.

source.excerpt: La Cour suprême du Canada est le plus haut tribunal de notre pays.

ar.question: المحكمة العليا لكندا هي أعلى محكمة في البلاد.
ar.explanation: صحيح. المحكمة العليا لكندا هي أعلى محكمة في البلاد.

en.question: The Supreme Court of Canada is the court that deals with matters concerning the federal government.
en.explanation: False. It is the Federal Court of Canada, not the Supreme Court, that deals with matters concerning the federal government.

source.excerpt: The Federal Court of Canada deals with matters concerning the federal government.

fr.question: C'est la Cour suprême du Canada qui s'occupe des questions concernant le gouvernement fédéral.
fr.explanation: Faux. C'est la Cour fédérale du Canada, et non la Cour suprême, qui s'occupe des questions concernant le gouvernement fédéral.

source.excerpt: La Cour fédérale du Canada s'occupe des questions concernant le gouvernement fédéral.

ar.question: المحكمة العليا لكندا هي المحكمة التي تتعامل مع المسائل المتعلقة بالحكومة الفيدرالية.
ar.explanation: خطأ. المحكمة الفيدرالية لكندا، وليست المحكمة العليا، هي التي تتعامل مع المسائل المتعلقة بالحكومة الفيدرالية.

en.question: Under Canada's justice system, who must prove guilt in a criminal case?
options: The prosecution must prove the accused is guilty
The accused must prove their own innocence
Neither side needs to prove anything
The judge decides guilt before the trial begins
en.explanation: Because everyone is presumed innocent until proven guilty, the prosecution bears the burden of proving guilt.

source.excerpt: Our judicial system is founded on the presumption of innocence in criminal matters, meaning everyone is innocent until proven guilty.

fr.question: Selon le système de justice du Canada, qui doit prouver la culpabilité dans une affaire criminelle ?
options: La poursuite doit prouver que l'accusé est coupable
L'accusé doit prouver sa propre innocence
Aucune des parties n'a besoin de prouver quoi que ce soit
Le juge décide de la culpabilité avant le début du procès
fr.explanation: Puisque chacun est présumé innocent jusqu'à preuve du contraire, c'est à la poursuite de prouver la culpabilité.

source.excerpt: Notre système judiciaire est fondé sur la présomption d'innocence dans les affaires criminelles, ce qui veut dire que chacun est innocent jusqu'à preuve du contraire.

ar.question: بموجب النظام القضائي الكندي، من يجب أن يثبت الإدانة في قضية جنائية؟
options: يجب على الادعاء إثبات إدانة المتهم
يجب على المتهم إثبات براءته بنفسه
لا يحتاج أي من الطرفين لإثبات أي شيء
يقرّر القاضي الإدانة قبل بدء المحاكمة
ar.explanation: بما أن الجميع يُفترض بريئًا حتى تثبت إدانته، يقع عبء إثبات الإدانة على الادعاء.

en.question: What body settles disputes in Canada's legal system?
en.explanation: Page 75: 'The courts settle disputes and the police enforce the laws.'

optionAnnotations.explanation: Page 75: 'The courts settle disputes and the police enforce the laws.'
Police enforce the laws (p. 75); they don't settle disputes.
Parliament makes laws (p. 55), the courts apply them.
The Senate reviews legislation (p. 55), not individual disputes.

en.question: What can lawyers do for a person facing a legal problem?
options: Help with legal problems and act for them in court
Only provide advice, never appear in court
Represent them only in criminal matters
Charge a fixed government-set fee for all services
en.explanation: The guide states lawyers can help with legal problems and act for you in court.

source.excerpt: If you cannot pay for a lawyer, in most communities there are legal aid services available free of charge or at a low cost.

fr.question: Que peuvent faire les avocats pour une personne confrontée à un problème juridique ?
options: Aider à résoudre des problèmes juridiques et représenter la personne en cour
Seulement donner des conseils, jamais se présenter en cour
La représenter seulement dans les affaires criminelles
Facturer des frais fixes établis par le gouvernement pour tous les services
fr.explanation: Le guide indique que les avocats peuvent aider à résoudre des problèmes juridiques et représenter une personne en cour.

source.excerpt: Si vous ne pouvez pas payer les services d'un avocat, la plupart des communautés offrent des services d'aide juridique gratuitement ou à un faible coût.

ar.question: ماذا يمكن للمحامين أن يفعلوا لشخص يواجه مشكلة قانونية؟
options: المساعدة في المشكلات القانونية والتصرف نيابةً عنه في المحكمة
تقديم المشورة فقط، دون المثول في المحكمة أبدًا
فرض رسم ثابت تحدده الحكومة لجميع الخدمات
ar.explanation: ينص الدليل على أن المحامين يمكنهم المساعدة في المشكلات القانونية والتصرف نيابةً عنك في المحكمة.

en.question: What can lawyers in Canada help you with?
options: Legal problems and acting for you in court
en.explanation: Page 77: 'Lawyers can help you with legal problems and act for you in court.'

optionAnnotations.explanation: Page 77: 'Lawyers can help you with legal problems and act for you in court.'
Lawyers help with all kinds of legal matters — civil, criminal, family, business — not just criminal.
Family lawyers handle divorce, but lawyers help with much more per p. 77.
No such cap on lawyer involvement per p. 77.

en.question: What can you access in most communities if you cannot pay for a lawyer?
options: Legal aid services, free of charge or at a low cost
A government-appointed lawyer only for criminal trials
No legal help is available without payment
Legal aid, but only for civil cases
en.explanation: Most communities offer legal aid services free of charge or at a low cost.

source.excerpt: If you cannot pay for a lawyer, in most communities there are legal aid services available free of charge or at a low cost.

fr.question: Qu'est-ce qui est offert dans la plupart des communautés si vous ne pouvez pas payer les services d'un avocat ?
options: Des services d'aide juridique, gratuitement ou à un faible coût
Un avocat nommé par le gouvernement seulement pour les procès criminels
Aucune aide juridique n'est disponible sans paiement
L'aide juridique, mais seulement pour les affaires civiles
fr.explanation: La plupart des communautés offrent des services d'aide juridique gratuitement ou à un faible coût.

source.excerpt: Si vous ne pouvez pas payer les services d'un avocat, la plupart des communautés offrent des services d'aide juridique gratuitement ou à un faible coût.

ar.question: ماذا يمكنك الوصول إليه في معظم المجتمعات إذا لم تكن قادرًا على دفع أتعاب محامٍ؟
options: خدمات المساعدة القانونية، مجانًا أو بتكلفة منخفضة
محامٍ معيَّن من الحكومة للمحاكمات الجنائية فقط
لا تتوفر أي مساعدة قانونية دون دفع
مساعدة قانونية، ولكن للقضايا المدنية فقط
ar.explanation: تقدّم معظم المجتمعات خدمات المساعدة القانونية مجانًا أو بتكلفة منخفضة.

en.question: What does the blindfolded figure of Lady Justice symbolize?
options: The impartial manner in which Canadian laws are administered — blind to all considerations but the facts
That judges are physically blindfolded during trials
That the law applies only at night
en.explanation: Page 75 photo caption: 'Scales of Justice, Vancouver Law Courts. The blindfolded Lady Justice symbolizes the impartial manner in which our laws are administered: blind to all considerations but the facts.'

optionAnnotations.explanation: Page 75 photo caption: 'Scales of Justice, Vancouver Law Courts. The blindfolded Lady Justice symbolizes the impartial manner in which our laws are administered: blind to all considerations but the facts.'
It's a symbolic figure — judges of course see the trial. The blindfold represents impartiality.
Not the meaning. Law applies any time.
Not the symbolic meaning of the blindfold per Discover Canada.

en.question: What is available in most Canadian communities for those who cannot afford a lawyer?
options: Legal aid services — free or at low cost
A public-defender system identical to the US
en.explanation: Page 77: 'If you cannot pay for a lawyer, in most communities there are legal aid services available free of charge or at a low cost.'

optionAnnotations.explanation: Page 77: 'If you cannot pay for a lawyer, in most communities there are legal aid services available free of charge or at a low cost.'
Legal aid exists to ensure access to representation (p. 77). Self-representation is an option but not the only one.
Not how it works. Legal aid is a service providing lawyers, not a court-system reroute.
Canadian legal aid serves a similar function but is structured differently — Discover Canada calls it 'legal aid services'.

en.question: What is 'due process'?
options: The principle that government must respect all the legal rights a person is entitled to under the law
The right to a free lawyer in every case
The requirement that all trials be televised
The process of appealing a parking ticket
en.explanation: Due process is the principle that government must respect all legal rights a person is entitled to.

source.excerpt: Due process is the principle that the government must respect all of the legal rights a person is entitled to under the law.

fr.question: Qu'est-ce que 'l'application régulière de la loi' ?
options: Le principe selon lequel le gouvernement doit respecter toutes les garanties juridiques auxquelles a droit une personne
Le droit à un avocat gratuit dans tous les cas
L'obligation de téléviser tous les procès
Le processus pour contester une contravention
fr.explanation: L'application régulière de la loi est le principe selon lequel le gouvernement doit respecter les garanties juridiques.

source.excerpt: L'application régulière de la loi est le principe selon lequel le gouvernement doit respecter toutes les garanties juridiques auxquelles a droit une personne en vertu de la loi.

ar.question: ما المقصود بـ 'الإجراءات القانونية الواجبة' (due process)؟
options: المبدأ القائل بأن الحكومة يجب أن تحترم جميع الحقوق القانونية التي يستحقها الشخص بموجب القانون
الحق في محامٍ مجاني في كل قضية
ar.explanation: الإجراءات القانونية الواجبة هي المبدأ القائل بأن الحكومة يجب أن تحترم جميع الحقوق القانونية التي يستحقها الشخص.

en.question: What is the intended purpose of laws in Canada?
options: Provide order, a peaceful way to settle disputes, and express Canadian values and beliefs
To raise revenue for the government
en.explanation: Page 75: 'Our laws are intended to provide order in society and a peaceful way to settle disputes, and to express the values and beliefs of Canadians.'

optionAnnotations.explanation: Page 75: 'Our laws are intended to provide order in society and a peaceful way to settle disputes, and to express the values and beliefs of Canadians.'
Some laws do involve taxation but that's not the overall purpose of law per p. 75.
Prisons do play 'an essential role in punishing criminals and deterring crime' (p. 76 caption), but it's a means, not the overall purpose.
Not a stated purpose in Discover Canada.

en.question: What is the primary role of the Royal Canadian Mounted Police (RCMP)?
options: Enforcing federal laws throughout Canada and serving as provincial police in most provinces
Only guarding the Prime Minister's residence
Serving exclusively as Ontario's provincial police
en.explanation: The RCMP enforces federal laws throughout Canada and serves as provincial police in most provinces and territories.

source.excerpt: The Royal Canadian Mounted Police (RCMP) enforce federal laws throughout Canada, and serve as the provincial police in all provinces and territories except Ontario and Quebec, as well as in some municipalities.

fr.question: Quel est le rôle principal de la Gendarmerie royale du Canada (GRC) ?
options: Appliquer les lois fédérales dans tout le Canada et servir de police provinciale dans la plupart des provinces
Seulement garder la résidence du premier ministre
S'occuper exclusivement des infractions routières municipales
Servir exclusivement de police provinciale en Ontario
fr.explanation: La GRC applique les lois fédérales dans l'ensemble du Canada et sert de police provinciale dans la plupart des provinces et territoires.

source.excerpt: La Gendarmerie royale du Canada (GRC) applique les lois fédérales dans l'ensemble du Canada et sert de police provinciale dans toutes les provinces et tous les territoires, sauf l'Ontario et le Québec, ainsi que dans certaines municipalités.

ar.question: ما الدور الأساسي للشرطة الملكية الكندية الخيّالة (RCMP)؟
options: إنفاذ القوانين الفيدرالية في جميع أنحاء كندا والعمل كشرطة إقليمية في معظم المقاطعات
حراسة مقر إقامة رئيس الوزراء فقط
التعامل حصريًا مع مخالفات المرور البلدية
ar.explanation: تُنفِذ الشرطة الملكية الكندية الخيّالة القوانين الفيدرالية في جميع أنحاء كندا وتعمل كشرطة إقليمية في معظم المقاطعات والأقاليم.

en.question: What is the role of the courts in Canada?
options: Courts settle disputes and ensure that laws are applied fairly
en.explanation: Page 75: 'The courts settle disputes and the police enforce the laws.' The judicial system is impartial — symbolized by the blindfolded Lady Justice.

optionAnnotations.explanation: Page 75: 'The courts settle disputes and the police enforce the laws.' The judicial system is impartial — symbolized by the blindfolded Lady Justice.
Laws are made by Parliament and provincial legislatures (p. 55) — the LEGISLATIVE branch. Courts INTERPRET law (judicial branch).
Tax collection is a function of the executive branch (CRA), not the courts.
Prisons are mentioned on page 76 ('Prisons have an essential role in punishing criminals') but they're managed by the executive branch (Correctional Services), not the courts.

en.question: What must the government do under the principle of due process?
options: Respect all the legal rights a person is entitled to under the law
en.explanation: Page 75: 'Due process is the principle that the government must respect all of legal rights a person is entitled to under the law.'

optionAnnotations.explanation: Page 75: 'Due process is the principle that the government must respect all of legal rights a person is entitled to under the law.'
Coerced confessions are not Canadian justice. Innocence is presumed (p. 75).
Canadian trials are generally public.
French civil law is one source (p. 11) — used in Quebec for civil matters — but Canadian justice draws on multiple traditions including English common law.

en.question: What option exists for Canadians who cannot afford a lawyer?
options: Legal aid services available free or at low cost in most communities
No help is available without full payment
Only a public defender for felony trials
Free representation, but only in provincial courts
en.explanation: Most communities offer legal aid services free of charge or at a low cost for those who cannot afford a lawyer.

source.excerpt: If you cannot pay for a lawyer, in most communities there are legal aid services available free of charge or at a low cost.

fr.question: Quelle option existe pour les Canadiens qui n'ont pas les moyens de payer un avocat ?
options: Des services d'aide juridique gratuits ou à faible coût dans la plupart des communautés
Aucune aide n'est disponible sans paiement complet
Seulement un avocat commis d'office pour les procès criminels graves
Une représentation gratuite, mais seulement devant les tribunaux provinciaux
fr.explanation: La plupart des communautés offrent des services d'aide juridique gratuitement ou à un faible coût pour ceux qui n'ont pas les moyens de payer un avocat.

source.excerpt: Si vous ne pouvez pas payer les services d'un avocat, la plupart des communautés offrent des services d'aide juridique gratuitement ou à un faible coût.

ar.question: ما الخيار المتاح للكنديين الذين لا يستطيعون تحمل تكلفة محامٍ؟
options: خدمات المساعدة القانونية المتاحة مجانًا أو بتكلفة منخفضة في معظم المجتمعات
لا تتوفر أي مساعدة دون دفع كامل
محامٍ عام للمحاكمات الجنائية الكبرى فقط
تمثيل مجاني، ولكن في المحاكم الإقليمية فقط
ar.explanation: تقدّم معظم المجتمعات خدمات المساعدة القانونية مجانًا أو بتكلفة منخفضة لمن لا يستطيعون تحمل تكلفة محامٍ.

en.question: What principle is Canada's judicial system founded on in criminal matters?
options: The presumption of innocence — everyone is innocent until proven guilty
The presumption of guilt — the accused must prove their innocence
Trial by jury is optional and rarely used
Only the victim's testimony is admissible in court
en.explanation: The judicial system is founded on the presumption of innocence.

source.excerpt: Our judicial system is founded on the presumption of innocence in criminal matters, meaning everyone is innocent until proven guilty.

fr.question: Sur quel principe le système judiciaire du Canada est-il fondé dans les affaires criminelles ?
options: La présomption d'innocence — chacun est innocent jusqu'à preuve du contraire
La présomption de culpabilité — l'accusé doit prouver son innocence
Le procès devant jury est facultatif
Seul le témoignage de la victime est admissible
fr.explanation: Le système judiciaire est fondé sur la présomption d'innocence.

source.excerpt: Notre système judiciaire est fondé sur la présomption d'innocence dans les affaires criminelles, ce qui veut dire que chacun est innocent jusqu'à preuve du contraire.

ar.question: على أي مبدأ يقوم النظام القضائي الكندي في المسائل الجنائية؟
options: افتراض البراءة — الجميع أبرياء حتى تثبت إدانتهم
افتراض الإدانة — يجب على المتهم إثبات براءته
المحاكمة أمام هيئة محلفين اختيارية ونادرة الاستخدام
شهادة الضحية فقط هي المقبولة في المحكمة
ar.explanation: يقوم النظام القضائي على افتراض البراءة.

en.question: What role do prisons play in Canada's justice system?
options: They have an essential role in punishing criminals and deterring crime
They serve only as labour camps
en.explanation: Page 76 photo caption: 'Prisons have an essential role in punishing criminals and deterring crime.'

optionAnnotations.explanation: Page 76 photo caption: 'Prisons have an essential role in punishing criminals and deterring crime.'
Discover Canada describes punishment + deterrence (p. 76).
Functional institutions per p. 76.
Prisons serve anyone convicted under Canadian law, regardless of origin (rule of law, p. 75).

en.question: When can you ask the Canadian police for help?
options: If there's been an accident, theft, assault, a crime in progress, or someone is missing
Only if you are a Canadian citizen
Only if you live in a major city
en.explanation: Page 76: 'You can ask the police for help in all kinds of situations — if there's been an accident, if someone has stolen something from you, if you are a victim of assault, if you see a crime taking place or if someone you know has gone missing.'

optionAnnotations.explanation: Page 76: 'You can ask the police for help in all kinds of situations — if there's been an accident, if someone has stolen something from you, if you are a victim of assault, if you see a crime taking place or if someone you know has gone missing.'
Police help everyone in Canada — citizens, residents, visitors. The 'all kinds of situations' line on p. 76 isn't citizenship-gated.
Police serve 24/7.
Police service is nationwide.

en.question: Which court deals with matters concerning the federal government?
en.explanation: The Federal Court of Canada deals with matters concerning the federal government.

source.excerpt: The Federal Court of Canada deals with matters concerning the federal government.

fr.explanation: La Cour fédérale du Canada s'occupe des questions concernant le gouvernement fédéral.

source.excerpt: La Cour fédérale du Canada s'occupe des questions concernant le gouvernement fédéral.

en.question: Which court is Canada's highest court?
en.explanation: The Supreme Court of Canada is the country's highest court.

source.excerpt: The Supreme Court of Canada is our country’s highest court.

fr.question: Quel tribunal est le plus haut tribunal du Canada ?
options: La Cour du Banc de la Reine
fr.explanation: La Cour suprême du Canada est le plus haut tribunal du pays.

source.excerpt: La Cour suprême du Canada est le plus haut tribunal de notre pays.

en.question: Which courts exist in most Canadian provinces?
options: Appeal courts, trial courts (sometimes called Court of Queen's Bench or Supreme Court), provincial courts for lesser offences, family courts, traffic courts, and small claims courts
Only the Supreme Court of Canada
en.explanation: Page 76: 'In most provinces there is an appeal court and a trial court, sometimes called the Court of Queen's Bench or the Supreme Court. There are also provincial courts for lesser offences, family courts, traffic courts and small claims courts.'

optionAnnotations.explanation: Page 76: 'In most provinces there is an appeal court and a trial court, sometimes called the Court of Queen's Bench or the Supreme Court. There are also provincial courts for lesser offences, family courts, traffic courts and small claims courts.'
The Supreme Court of Canada is the highest national court; provinces have their own multi-tiered courts.
Federal Court handles federal-government matters; provinces have their own courts.
Military courts are a small specialty system; civilian justice is far broader per p. 76.

en.question: Which of the following best summarizes the concept of 'due process' in Canada?
options: Government must respect a person's legal rights under the law
Every case must be resolved within 24 hours
Only lawyers may speak in court
Trials must always include a jury
en.explanation: Due process means the government must respect all the legal rights a person is entitled to under the law.

source.excerpt: Due process is the principle that the government must respect all of the legal rights a person is entitled to under the law.

fr.question: Laquelle des affirmations suivantes résume le mieux le concept de 'l'application régulière de la loi' au Canada ?
options: Le gouvernement doit respecter les garanties juridiques d'une personne en vertu de la loi
Chaque affaire doit être résolue dans les 24 heures
Seuls les avocats peuvent parler en cour
Les procès doivent toujours inclure un jury
fr.explanation: L'application régulière de la loi signifie que le gouvernement doit respecter toutes les garanties juridiques auxquelles une personne a droit en vertu de la loi.

source.excerpt: L'application régulière de la loi est le principe selon lequel le gouvernement doit respecter toutes les garanties juridiques auxquelles a droit une personne en vertu de la loi.

options: يجب على الحكومة احترام الحقوق القانونية للشخص بموجب القانون
يجب حل كل قضية خلال 24 ساعة

en.question: Which of these court types is NOT part of Canada's court system?
en.explanation: The guide lists the Supreme Court, Federal Court, provincial/trial courts, family, traffic, and small claims courts — not an international tribunal.

source.excerpt: The Supreme Court of Canada is our country’s highest court.

source.excerpt: La Cour suprême du Canada est le plus haut tribunal de notre pays.

Supreme Court of Canada — only traffic violations

source.excerpt: The Federal Court of Canada deals with matters concerning the federal government.

La Cour suprême du Canada — seulement les infractions routières

Le tribunal de la famille — les questions du gouvernement fédéral

المحكمة العليا لكندا — مخالفات المرور فقط

en.question: Which statement correctly describes the presumption of innocence in Canada?
options: Everyone is innocent until proven guilty
Everyone is guilty until proven innocent
Only citizens benefit from this presumption
It applies only to minor offences
en.explanation: Discover Canada states everyone is innocent until proven guilty, applying to all criminal matters.

source.excerpt: Our judicial system is founded on the presumption of innocence in criminal matters, meaning everyone is innocent until proven guilty.

fr.question: Laquelle des affirmations suivantes décrit correctement la présomption d'innocence au Canada ?
options: Chacun est innocent jusqu'à preuve du contraire

source.excerpt: The Royal Canadian Mounted Police (RCMP) enforce federal laws throughout Canada, and serve as the provincial police in all provinces and territories except Ontario and Quebec, as well as in some municipalities.

fr.question: Quelles deux provinces maintiennent leur propre service de police provincial distinct plutôt que de dépendre de la GRC ?

ar.question: أي مقاطعتين تحتفظان بقوة شرطة إقليمية خاصة بهما بدلاً من الاعتماد على الشرطة الملكية الكندية الخيّالة؟

en.question: Who is bound by the law in Canada?
options: Everyone, including judges, politicians, and the police
Only people who have been convicted of a crime

optionAnnotations.explanation: Page 75: 'The law in Canada applies to everyone, including judges, politicians and the police.' Page 13 calls this the 'rule of law' — a founding principle.
The opposite of the rule of law. Discover Canada emphasizes that no one is above the law (p. 13: 'No person or group is above the law').
The law governs everyone's conduct, not just those who have broken it.
All people in Canada — citizens, residents, visitors — are subject to the law.
